mentions.name: snowpack
mentions.description: Small frontend utilities that overlay custom geo data on top of each other, used to visualize snow depth across California ski destinations and to build a heat map of national park traffic by entrance.
mentions.source_excerpt: Geo data mashups (https://github.com/cloudkj/snowpack) - small frontend utilities to overlay custom data on top of each other; was able to satisfy two recent personal use cases: (1) visualize snow depth across California ski destinations and (2) heat map of national park traffic by entrance.
